rules.question: What is a path's running score, given its six score categories?
rules.note: A running score built by adding category fields by hand next to the owner. This catches only the hand sum; a seventh category arrives under a new name, so no text search catches a category missing from the sum, and emit_path's runtime check in src/search/engine.cpp is the guard for that. Decided by: concept audit M30 (D114, task F7)

rules.question: Which search graph does a set of search settings build?

owner_lines.why: search_graph, the owner: the graph's fill rule and rules from the settings

rules.note: A ScoreGraph built from settings by hand instead of through search_graph, which every analysis and target search shares (D45). Scoped to src: tools/bench.cpp times the build by itself and keeps its copy, and tests build graphs at chosen caps on purpose. Decided by: concept audit M35 (D114, task F7)

rules.question: How many beats before a fill does Clone Hero 1.1's fill deadline fall, in words?
rules.owner: fill_rule_description in src/search/graph.h (the number is kCh11FillLeadBeats)
must_match: : name + " sets the deadline 4 beats before the fill starts.";
ImGui::TextUnformatted("The deadline is four beats before the fill.");
must_not_match: // The E threshold: a fixed lead in beats before the fill marker.
rules.note: A sentence that states the 1.1 fill lead's number by hand. fill_rule_description writes it from kCh11FillLeadBeats, so the sentence follows the code. Tests pin the full sentence as a literal on purpose and are out of scope. Decided by: concept audit M38 (D114, task F7)
